unflaggedAssumptions: The IRA is not an inherited/beneficiary IRA; the model applies to an owner’s traditional IRA using Table III, not to inherited IRAs (which use Table I).

The provided priorYearEndBalanceUsd is already the IRS RMD valuation balance after any required adjustments (e.g., outstanding rollovers/transfers/recharacterizations at year-end, QLAC exclusions, annuitized asset valuation), not a raw statement balance that would need adjustments.
unitIssues: Parameter applicableDenominator is labeled with unit "year" but is used as a dimensionless life-expectancy factor; dividing USD by a quantity in years yields USD/year, while the output rmdUsd is labeled "usd". This is a unit mismatch.
If rmdPctOfBalance is derived from applicableDenominator (e.g., 100/denominator), treating the denominator as "year" would imply "percent per year" rather than unitless "percent".
